findings.risk: The bucket could be exposed to the public internet through ACLs or bucket policies, leading to unauthorized access to stored data.
findings.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource for aws_s3_bucket.data with block_public_acls=true, ignore_public_acls=true, block_public_policy=true, and restrict_public_buckets=true.

findings.risk: Data stored in the bucket may be exposed if underlying storage is accessed improperly or if encryption requirements are mandated for sensitive data.
findings.remediation: Add a server_side_encryption_configuration block to aws_s3_bucket.data and set apply_server_side_encryption_by_default.sse_algorithm to aws:kms or AES256.

findings.risk: Object-level and request activity will not be logged, reducing visibility for detecting unauthorized access or supporting forensic investigations.
findings.remediation: Add a logging block to aws_s3_bucket.data with target_bucket set to a dedicated log bucket such as aws_s3_bucket.logs.id and an appropriate target_prefix.

findings.risk: Accidental deletion, overwrite, or ransomware-style modification of objects may be irreversible.
findings.remediation: Add a versioning block to aws_s3_bucket.data with enabled = true.

findings.risk: The bucket and all contents can be deleted by Terraform without manual cleanup, increasing the risk of destructive data loss.
findings.remediation: Set force_destroy = false on aws_s3_bucket.data.

findings.issue: Sensitive object stored without explicit server-side encryption controls
findings.risk: The uploaded object may be stored unencrypted because the destination bucket has no default encryption, exposing sensitive file contents such as customer data.
findings.remediation: Either enable default bucket encryption on aws_s3_bucket.data or set server_side_encryption = "aws:kms" (or "AES256") on aws_s3_bucket_object.data_object and specify kms_key_id if using KMS.

findings.risk: Sensitive financial data may be stored unencrypted at rest, increasing exposure in the event of unauthorized access or noncompliance.
findings.remediation: Add a server_side_encryption_configuration block to aws_s3_bucket.financials and set apply_server_side_encryption_by_default.sse_algorithm to aws:kms or AES256.

findings.risk: Access to sensitive financial data will not be logged, limiting monitoring and incident investigation capabilities.
findings.remediation: Add a logging block to aws_s3_bucket.financials with target_bucket set to a dedicated log bucket such as aws_s3_bucket.logs.id and an appropriate target_prefix.

findings.risk: Accidental or malicious changes to financial data may not be recoverable.
findings.remediation: Add a versioning block to aws_s3_bucket.financials with enabled = true.

findings.risk: Even with a private ACL, the bucket can still be made public through bucket policies or future ACL changes.
findings.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource for aws_s3_bucket.financials with block_public_acls=true, ignore_public_acls=true, block_public_policy=true, and restrict_public_buckets=true.

findings.risk: The bucket and all financial data can be deleted by Terraform without additional safeguards, causing irreversible data loss.
findings.remediation: Set force_destroy = false on aws_s3_bucket.financials.

findings.risk: Operational data may be stored unencrypted at rest, increasing the impact of unauthorized access and weakening data protection controls.
findings.remediation: Add a server_side_encryption_configuration block to aws_s3_bucket.operations and set apply_server_side_encryption_by_default.sse_algorithm to aws:kms or AES256.

findings.risk: Access events will not be captured, reducing the ability to audit activity and investigate suspicious behavior.
findings.remediation: Add a logging block to aws_s3_bucket.operations with target_bucket set to a dedicated log bucket such as aws_s3_bucket.logs.id and an appropriate target_prefix.

findings.risk: The bucket may still become publicly accessible via policy or ACL changes despite acl being set to private.
findings.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource for aws_s3_bucket.operations with block_public_acls=true, ignore_public_acls=true, block_public_policy=true, and restrict_public_buckets=true.

findings.risk: Terraform can delete the bucket and all operational data without manual confirmation, increasing the chance of accidental data loss.
findings.remediation: Set force_destroy = false on aws_s3_bucket.operations.

findings.risk: Data science data may be stored unencrypted at rest, exposing potentially sensitive datasets.
findings.remediation: Add a server_side_encryption_configuration block to aws_s3_bucket.data_science and set apply_server_side_encryption_by_default.sse_algorithm to aws:kms or AES256.

findings.risk: The bucket can still be exposed publicly through bucket policy or ACL changes even though acl is private.
findings.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource for aws_s3_bucket.data_science with block_public_acls=true, ignore_public_acls=true, block_public_policy=true, and restrict_public_buckets=true.

findings.risk: The bucket and its datasets can be destroyed automatically by Terraform, causing preventable data loss.
findings.remediation: Set force_destroy = false on aws_s3_bucket.data_science.

findings.risk: Log data could be exposed publicly through ACL or policy misconfiguration, disclosing sensitive access patterns and metadata.
findings.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource for aws_s3_bucket.logs with block_public_acls=true, ignore_public_acls=true, block_public_policy=true, and restrict_public_buckets=true.

findings.risk: Access to the log bucket itself will not be recorded, limiting visibility into unauthorized access to audit data.
findings.remediation: Add a logging block to aws_s3_bucket.logs with target_bucket set to a separate dedicated log bucket and an appropriate target_prefix.

findings.risk: Audit logs can be deleted automatically by Terraform, undermining retention and forensic requirements.
findings.remediation: Set force_destroy = false on aws_s3_bucket.logs.
